0.label: Hot & Humid (Tropical / Sultry Monsoon)
0.description: Characterized by elevated ambient temperatures, high atmospheric moisture content, moderate wind speeds, and lower surface atmospheric pressure. Frequently brings convective precipitation.
0.agricultural_impact: High fungal disease risk in crops; favorable for paddy and tropical plantations; require vigilant irrigation drainage.
0.energy_consumption: Maximum air conditioning and cooling load; increased peak electricity demand.
0.outdoor_comfort: Uncomfortable / muggy heat stress index; prolonged exertion not advised during peak afternoon.
0.hazard_risk: Moderate to High (Flash showers, lightning risk, heat-stress warnings).

1.label: Cold & Dry (Winter Continental Fair)
1.description: Marked by low ambient temperatures, low humidity, steady barometric high-pressure ridge, and crisp clean air with near-zero precipitation.
1.agricultural_impact: Frost warning for sensitive horticultural crops; ideal for rabi wheat and dormancy phases.
1.energy_consumption: High indoor space heating load; minimal cooling requirement.
1.outdoor_comfort: Chilly to crisp; wind-chill sensations; thermal clothing strongly recommended.
1.hazard_risk: Low to Moderate (Ground frost, hypothermia risk for vulnerable populations).

2.label: Stormy & Unstable (Deep Depression / Gale)
2.description: Driven by severe barometric pressure drops (cyclonic low), extreme gusty winds, atmospheric saturation (humidity > 85%), and prolonged heavy precipitation.
2.agricultural_impact: High risk of waterlogging, crop lodging, and topsoil erosion; field operations suspended.
2.energy_consumption: Grid vulnerability to storm damage; localized brownouts and power surges.
2.outdoor_comfort: Extremely poor; hazardous outdoor conditions; zero recreational viability.
2.hazard_risk: High (Flooding, fallen trees, travel disruption, severe squalls).

3.label: Hot & Arid (Subtropical Heatwave)
3.description: Intense thermal radiation, low relative humidity, moderate desiccating winds, and high evaporative atmospheric demand without precipitation.
3.agricultural_impact: Severe evapotranspiration; rapid soil moisture depletion; acute irrigation demands.
3.energy_consumption: Heavy continuous air-conditioning load; transformer stress under ambient heat.
3.outdoor_comfort: Severe heatstroke risk; dehydration alert; shade and hydration mandatory.
3.hazard_risk: High (Wildfire risk, heatstroke, heat exhaustion alert).

4.label: Pleasant & Temperate (Mild Spring / Autumn)
4.description: Optimal thermal neutrality with temperatures in the 18-24°C range, comfortable humidity (45-60%), gentle breezes, and stable standard atmospheric pressure (~1013-1016 hPa).
4.agricultural_impact: Optimal growing conditions for broad-acre farming, flowering, and pollination.
4.energy_consumption: Minimal baseline HVAC energy demand; natural ventilation preferred.
4.outdoor_comfort: Optimal outdoor comfort index; ideal for eco-tourism and outdoor work.
